paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai in Philistia mite'n asepaihte uh Israel mite sual a dou ding in akaikhawm uh. Akish in David kiang ah, "Nang leh na mite kei toh galdou dia na hong kuan ngeingei ding uh ahi, chih thei in," achi hi.
english: In those days, the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. Achish said to David, “Know assuredly that you will go out with me in the army, you and your men.”

paite: David in Akish kiang ah, "Aw le, na sikha in bang ahihthei a chih na thei ding," achi hi. Akish in David kiang ah, "Ahoih ve, kei hon vengpa ding in ka hon bawl den ding," achi hi.
english: David said to Achish, “Therefore you will know what your servant can do.” Achish said to David, “Therefore I will make you my bodyguard forever.”

paite: Samuel asita a, Israel mi tengteng in akah ua, amah khua mah Ramah ah avui uhi. Saul in dawi aisan siam zawlte leh dawisiamte agam a pan adelhkhe khin hi.
heading: Saul In Dawisiam Adong
english: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. Saul had sent away those who had familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land.

paite: Philistia mite akikaikhawm ua, Shunem ah panmun akhoh uh. Saul in Israel mi tengteng akaikhawm a, Gilboa ah panmun akhoh sam hi.
english: The Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem; and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa.

paite: Saul in Philistia sepaihte amuhtak in alau a, alungsim aling tonton maimah hi.
english: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly.

paite: Saul in TOUPA adot in leng TOUPA'N mang hiam, Urim hiam, zawlnei hiam in leng adawng himhim kei hi.
english: When Saul inquired of Yahweh, Yahweh didn’t answer him by dreams, by Urim, or by prophets.

paite: Saul in asikhate kiang ah, "Dawi aisan siam zawl numei akiang a ka hoh a ka dot ding hon zonkhiaksak un," achi hi. Asikhate'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, Endor a dawi aisan siam numei om ei ve," achi uhi.
english: Then Saul said to his servants, “Seek for me a woman who has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her and inquire of her.” His servants said to him, “Behold, there is a woman who has a familiar spirit at Endor.”

paite: Saul akibawl lamdang a, puan dang asilh a, amah leh midang nih ahoh uh. Zan in numei kiang ava tung uhi. "Dawi aisanna in ai hon sansak inla, na kiang a, amin ka gen peuhmah hon sapsak in," achi hi.
english: Saul disguised himself and put on other clothing, and went, he and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night. Then he said, “Please consult for me by the familiar spirit, and bring me up whomever I shall name to you.”

paite: Numei in akiang ah, "Ngai in, Saul thilhih na thei a, agam a dawi aisan siam leh dawisiamte ahihmang khinta a, bangziak a ka sihna dia ka hinna thang kamkhum dia kisa na hia?" achi hi.
english: The woman said to him, “Behold, you know what Saul has done, how he has cut off those who have familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land. Why then do you lay a snare for my life, to cause me to die?”

paite: Saul in, "TOUPA min lou in, TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Hiai thil ziak in na tung ah gawtna atung kei ding," chi in akiang ah akichiam hi.
english: Saul swore to her by Yahweh, saying, “As Yahweh lives, no punishment will happen to you for this thing.”

paite: Numei in, "Kua ka hon sapkhiaksak dia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Samuel hon sapkhiaksak in," achi hi.
english: Then the woman said, “Whom shall I bring up to you?” He said, “Bring Samuel up for me.”

paite: Numei in Samuel amuhleh ngaihtak in akikou a, Saul kiang ah, "Bangziak a hon khem, Saul lah na hi ngal a?" achi hi.
english: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice; and the woman spoke to Saul, saying, “Why have you deceived me? For you are Saul!”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Lau ke'n. Bang a na muh?" achi hi. Numei in Saul kiang ah, "Lei a pan pathiante hong pawtkhia ka mu,” achi hi.
english: The king said to her, “Don’t be afraid! What do you see?” The woman said to Saul, “I see a god coming up out of the earth.”

paite: Akiang ah, "Bangchibang ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Putekpi ahong pawt a, puanaktual asilh," achi hi. Saul in Samuel ahi chih athei a, amai a lei in akun hi.
english: He said to her, “What does he look like?” She said, “An old man comes up. He is covered with a robe.” Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he bowed with his face to the ground, and showed respect.

paite: Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "Bangziak a hihbuai a hon samkhia na hia?" achi hi. Saul in adawng a, "Ka lung azing mahmah a ahi. Philistia mite'n ahon dou ua, Pathian in lah ahon lehngatsan a, zawlnei hiam, mang hiam in leng lah ahon dawng himhim kei hi. Huaiziak in ka hih ding hon hilh ding in ka hon sam ahi," achi hi.
english: Samuel said to Saul, “Why have you disturbed me, to bring me up?” Saul answered, “I am very distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God has departed from me, and answers me no more, by prophets, or by dreams. Therefore I have called you, that you may make known to me what I shall do.”

paite: Samuel in, "Huchi a TOUPA hon lehngatsan in na melma ahong hita, chih theigige kawm a bangziak a thu hon dong?
english: Samuel said, “Why then do you ask me, since Yahweh has departed from you and has become your adversary?

paite: Kei hon zang a, agen bang in TOUPA'N na tung a hih ahita ve. TOUPA'N na khut a pan gam ahon sut a, na invengpa David apeta hi.
english: Yahweh has done to you as he spoke by me. Yahweh has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor, even to David.

paite: TOUPA thu na man louh ziak leh Amalekte tung a aheh mahmah dungzui a na tangtun louh ziak in. Tu in na tung ah hiai thil ahihta hi.
english: Because you didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice, and didn’t execute his fierce wrath on Amalek, therefore Yahweh has done this thing to you today.

paite: Huai lou leng, TOUPA'N nang leh Israelte leng Philistia mite khut ah ahon pe dia; zingchiang in nang leh na tapate ka kiang ah na hong om ding uh. TOUPA'N Israel sepaihte leng Philistia mite khut ah ape ding," achi hi.
english: Moreover Yahweh will deliver Israel also with you into the hand of the Philistines; and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. Yahweh will deliver the army of Israel also into the hand of the Philistines.”

paite: Huchi in Samuel thugen ziak in Saul alau mahmah a, lei ah apuk vialvual maimah hi. Tha leh zung himhim anei kei; nitum leh zankhua a an ne lou ahi ngal a.
english: Then Saul fell immediately his full length on the earth, and was terrified, because of Samuel’s words. There was no strength in him, for he had eaten no bread all day long or all night long.

paite: Saul kiang ah numeinu ahoh a, adah mahmah chih athei hi. Akiang ah, "Ngai in, na sikhanu'n na gen ka taksang a, sih-le-sih ka kiang a na thugente ka zui hi.
english: The woman came to Saul and saw that he was very troubled, and said to him, “Behold, your servant has listened to your voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have listened to your words which you spoke to me.

paite: Huaiziak in nang leng na sikhanu thu taksang sam in. An tawmchik bek ka hon lui dia, huchi in na pai chiang a hatna na neihtheihna ding in ne in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, please listen also to the voice of your servant, and let me set a morsel of bread before you. Eat, that you may have strength when you go on your way.”

paite: Himahleh a-ut kei a, "Ka ne kei ding,” achi hi. Himahleh asikhate'n numei toh asawl teitei ua; a thu uh amangta hi. Lei a pan athou a, lupna ah atuta hi.
english: But he refused, and said, “I will not eat.” But his servants, together with the woman, constrained him; and he listened to their voice. So he arose from the earth and sat on the bed.

paite: Numei in a-inn ah bawngnou vak thau anei a, agou zok a; tangbuang ala a, amek a, silngou soh louh tanghou abawl hi.
english: The woman had a fattened calf in the house. She hurried and killed it; and she took flour and kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread of it.

paite: Saul leh asikhate ma ah alui a, aneta uh. Huchi in athou ua, huai zan in apaita uhi.
english: She brought it before Saul and before his servants, and they ate. Then they rose up and went away that night.
